instruction: In apps/daemon/src/token-command.ts, runTokenCommand formats the CLI login URL fragment using URLSearchParams({ token }).toString(), which encodes spaces as "+" instead of "%20" and fails to round-trip reserved characters such as spaces, "+", "&", "=", "%", and "#" when parsed back by consumeLoginFragment. Build the login URL fragment with encodeURIComponent(token) so reserved characters round-trip accurately.
